answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 16222 Country: India Title: mere papa mere liye kuch pasa rakhte hai ki humko haj ke liye bhejege aur woh paisa ek box me rakhata paisa kise ko bhi dete hai ki box me rakh do to kya is pasise par zakat hoge Question: mere papa mere liye kuch pasa rakhte hai ki humko haj ke liye bhejege aur woh paisa ek box me rakhata paisa kise ko bhi dete hai ki box me rakh do to kya is pasise par zakat hoge Answer ID: 16222 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1527/1527/M=1430) If the money is equal to nisab or it is less than nisab but the nisab completes with other money, then in both the cases, the money collected in box will be liable for Zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
